# Pega to Present at Upcoming Investor Conference


**WALTHAM, Mass. – November 4, 2026 –**[Pegasystems Inc.](https://www.pega.com/) (NASDAQ: PEGA), the enterprise AI software company for mission-critical work, today announced that Ken Stillwell, COO and CFO, will be presenting at the following upcoming investor conference:


- **RBC Capital Markets Global Technology, Internet, Media & Telecommunications Conference** ([https://kvgo.com/rbc/pegasystems-inc-november](https://kvgo.com/rbc/pegasystems-inc-november) ). Ken Stillwell will host an in-person Pega presentation, scheduled for Wednesday, November 18, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. EST (7:00 a.m. PST) in New York, NY.


The presentation archive will be available on Pega’s[Investors](https://www.pega.com/investors) page for a limited time.
